-- Kiểm tra chéo cân đối kế toán theo từng mã / kỳ.

    select

    from (

            max(case when metric_id = 'BS_TOTAL_LIABILITIES' then value end)            as total_liabilities,

        from `vnstock-medallion-nhom10`.`silver`.`stg_balance_sheet`
        group by symbol, period, period_end_date

    select 'OHLC_INCONSISTENT' as rule_code, 'warn' as severity, 'price_daily_raw' as source_table,

           cast(null as string) as business_key,
           close as observed_value,
           'high/low không bao trùm open/close' as detail
    from price where not is_ohlc_consistent

    union all
    select 'NON_POSITIVE_PRICE', 'error', 'price_daily_raw', 'stg_price_daily', symbol, trade_date,
           cast(null as string), close, 'giá OHLC <= 0 hoặc NULL'
    from price where not is_price_positive

    union all
    select 'NEGATIVE_VOLUME', 'error', 'price_daily_raw', 'stg_price_daily', symbol, trade_date,
           cast(null as string), cast(volume as float64), 'khối lượng âm hoặc NULL'
    from price where not is_volume_valid

    select 'ZERO_VOLUME', 'warn', 'price_daily_raw', 'stg_price_daily', symbol, trade_date,
           cast(null as string), cast(volume as float64), 'phiên không có khối lượng khớp'
    from price where volume = 0

    union all
    select 'MULTIPLE_VERSIONS', 'info', 'price_daily_raw', 'stg_price_daily', symbol, trade_date,
           cast(null as string), cast(version_count as float64),
           'khóa xuất hiện ở nhiều batch; Silver giữ bản trích xuất mới nhất'
    from price where version_count > 1

    union all
    select 'RETURN_EXCEEDS_PRICE_LIMIT', 'info', 'price_daily_raw', 'stg_price_daily', symbol, trade_date,
           cast(null as string), close / prev_close - 1,
           'biến động ngày vượt biên độ sàn - có thể do giá điều chỉnh hoặc phiên đặc biệt'
    from price_ret
    where prev_close > 0
      and abs(close / prev_close - 1) > case when exchange = 'HOSE' or exchange is null
                                             then 0.075
                                             else 0.105 end

    union all
    select 'MISSING_TRADING_DAY', 'warn', 'price_daily_raw', 'stg_price_daily', r.symbol, m.trade_date,
           cast(null as string), cast(null as float64),
           'thị trường có giao dịch nhưng mã không có bản ghi giá'
    from symbol_range r
    inner join market_calendar m on m.trade_date between r.first_date and r.last_date
    left join price p on p.symbol = r.symbol and p.trade_date = m.trade_date
    where p.symbol is null

    union all
    select 'OHLC_INCONSISTENT', 'warn', 'index_daily_raw', 'stg_index_daily', index_code, trade_date,
           cast(null as string), close, 'high/low không bao trùm open/close'
    from idx where not is_ohlc_consistent

    union all
    select 'NON_POSITIVE_PRICE', 'error', 'index_daily_raw', 'stg_index_daily', index_code, trade_date,
           cast(null as string), close, 'giá trị chỉ số <= 0 hoặc NULL'
    from idx where not is_price_positive

    union all
    select 'INVALID_PERIOD', 'error', report_type || '_raw', 'stg_' || report_type, symbol,
           cast(null as date), period || '|' || metric_id, cast(null as float64),
           'kỳ báo cáo không đúng định dạng YYYY-Qn'
    from fin where fiscal_year is null or fiscal_quarter is null

    union all
    select 'CORE_METRIC_MISSING', 'warn', report_type || '_raw', 'stg_' || report_type, symbol,
           period_end_date, period || '|' || metric_id, cast(null as float64),
           'chỉ tiêu cốt lõi NULL ở nguồn (không quy về 0)'
    from fin
    where value is null
      and metric_id in (
          'IS_NET_PROFIT_AFTER_TAX', 'BS_TOTAL_ASSETS', 'BS_TOTAL_LIABILITIES', 'BS_EQUITY',
          'BS_TOTAL_LIABILITIES_AND_EQUITY', 'CF_NET_CASH_FLOWS_FROM_OPERATING_ACTIVITIES'
      )

    union all
    select 'BALANCE_IDENTITY_VIOLATED', 'warn', 'balance_sheet_raw', 'stg_balance_sheet', symbol,
           period_end_date, period, (total_liabilities + equity) / total_liabilities_and_equity,
           'Nợ phải trả + Vốn chủ sở hữu khác Tổng nguồn vốn quá ngưỡng 0.02'
    from balance_check
    where total_liabilities_and_equity > 0
      and abs((total_liabilities + equity) / total_liabilities_and_equity - 1) > 0.02

    union all
    select 'PERIOD_SCALE_ANOMALY', 'warn', 'balance_sheet_raw', 'stg_balance_sheet', symbol,
           period_end_date, period || '|scale', equity / median_equity,
           'Vốn chủ sở hữu của kỳ lệch hơn 2.0 lần so với trung vị các kỳ của mã - nghi số cộng dồn nhiều kỳ'
    from balance_check
    where median_equity > 0
      and (equity / median_equity > 2.0
           or equity / median_equity < 1.0 / 2.0)

    union all
    select 'UNEXPECTED_UNIT', 'warn', report_type || '_raw', 'stg_' || report_type, symbol,
           period_end_date, period || '|' || metric_id, cast(null as float64),
           'đơn vị khác VND: ' || coalesce(unit, 'NULL')
    from fin where unit is null or unit <> 'VND'

)

-- Lưu ý từ profiling:
--   * BS_TOTAL_ASSETS luôn NULL ở nguồn -> tổng tài sản lấy từ BS_TOTAL_LIABILITIES_AND_EQUITY
--     (tổng nguồn vốn = tổng tài sản theo đẳng thức kế toán); cột total_assets_basis ghi rõ.
--   * Ngân hàng không có "doanh thu thuần": dùng tổng thu nhập hoạt động (cộng 6 khoản thu nhập thuần).
--   * NULL không quy về 0; tỷ số để NULL khi thiếu tử/mẫu số.
--   * ROE/ROA tính trên số dư CUỐI kỳ của một quý, chưa quy năm.
--   * Kỳ 2025-Q4 ở nguồn có quy mô gấp ~4 lần các quý 2026 ở MỌI mã (nghi là số cộng dồn cả năm
--     gắn nhãn Q4). Kỳ như vậy được gắn is_period_suspect = true và KHÔNG dùng để tính tăng trưởng QoQ.

with f as (

    select * from `vnstock-medallion-nhom10`.`gold`.`fact_financial_metric`

),

pivoted as (

    select
        ticker_key,
        symbol,
        period,
        fiscal_year,
        fiscal_quarter,
        period_end_date,
        period_end_date_key,
        max(case when metric_id = 'IS_NET_REVENUE' then value end)                                  as net_revenue,
        sum(case when metric_id in ('IS_NET_INTEREST_INCOME', 'IS_NET_FEE_AND_COMMISSION_INCOME', 'IS_NET_GAIN_LOSS_FROM_FOREIGN_CURRENCIES_AND_GOLD_TRADING', 'IS_NET_GAIN_LOSS_FROM_TRADING_SECURITIES', 'IS_NET_GAIN_LOSS_FROM_INVESTMENT_SECURITIES', 'IS_NET_OTHER_INCOME') then value end) as bank_operating_income,
        max(case when metric_id = 'IS_GROSS_PROFIT' then value end)                                 as gross_profit,
        max(case when metric_id = 'IS_OPERATING_PROFIT' then value end)                             as operating_profit,
        max(case when metric_id = 'IS_PROFIT_BEFORE_TAX' then value end)                            as profit_before_tax,
        max(case when metric_id = 'IS_NET_PROFIT_AFTER_TAX' then value end)                         as net_profit_after_tax,
        max(case when metric_id = 'IS_PROFIT_AFTER_TAX_FOR_SHAREHOLDERS_OF_PARENT_COMPANY' then value end) as net_profit_parent,
        max(case when metric_id = 'BS_TOTAL_ASSETS' then value end)                                 as total_assets_reported,
        max(case when metric_id = 'BS_TOTAL_LIABILITIES_AND_EQUITY' then value end)                 as total_liabilities_and_equity,
        max(case when metric_id = 'BS_TOTAL_LIABILITIES' then value end)                            as total_liabilities,
        max(case when metric_id = 'BS_EQUITY' then value end)                                       as equity,
        max(case when metric_id = 'BS_CASH_AND_PRECIOUS_METALS' then value end)                     as cash_and_equivalents,
        max(case when metric_id = 'CF_NET_CASH_FLOWS_FROM_OPERATING_ACTIVITIES' then value end)     as net_cash_from_operating,
        max(case when metric_id = 'CF_NET_CASH_FLOWS_FROM_INVESTING_ACTIVITIES' then value end)     as net_cash_from_investing,
        max(case when metric_id = 'CF_NET_CASH_FLOWS_FROM_FINANCING_ACTIVITIES' then value end)     as net_cash_from_financing,
        count(*)                                                      as metrics_total,
        sum(case when value is not null then 1 else 0 end)            as metrics_with_value
    from f
    group by ticker_key, symbol, period, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, period_end_date, period_end_date_key

),

base as (

    select
        p.*,
        t.financial_template,
        case when t.financial_template = 'bank' then p.bank_operating_income else p.net_revenue end as revenue,
        case when t.financial_template = 'bank' then 'total_operating_income' else 'net_revenue' end as revenue_basis,
        coalesce(p.total_assets_reported, p.total_liabilities_and_equity) as total_assets,
        case
            when p.total_assets_reported is not null then 'BS_TOTAL_ASSETS'
            when p.total_liabilities_and_equity is not null then 'BS_TOTAL_LIABILITIES_AND_EQUITY'
        end                                                           as total_assets_basis
    from pivoted p
    inner join `vnstock-medallion-nhom10`.`gold`.`dim_ticker` t on t.ticker_key = p.ticker_key

),

flagged as (

    select
        *,
        percentile_cont(equity, 0.5) over (partition by symbol) as median_equity
    from base

),

checked as (

    select
        *,
        case when total_liabilities_and_equity > 0
             then (total_liabilities + equity) / total_liabilities_and_equity end as balance_identity_ratio,
        case when median_equity > 0 then equity / median_equity end           as equity_scale_ratio
    from flagged

),

suspect as (

    select
        *,
        coalesce(abs(balance_identity_ratio - 1) > 0.02, false)
            or coalesce(equity_scale_ratio > 2.0
                        or equity_scale_ratio < 1.0 / 2.0, false) as is_period_suspect
    from checked

),

with_prev as (

    select
        *,
        lag(is_period_suspect) over (partition by symbol order by period_end_date)    as prev_is_period_suspect,
        lag(revenue) over (partition by symbol order by period_end_date)              as prev_revenue,
        lag(net_profit_after_tax) over (partition by symbol order by period_end_date) as prev_net_profit_after_tax,
        lag(period) over (partition by symbol order by period_end_date)               as prev_period
    from suspect

)

select
    ticker_key,
    period_end_date_key,
    symbol,
    financial_template,
    period,
    fiscal_year,
    fiscal_quarter,
    period_end_date,
    'VND'                                                             as unit,
    revenue,
    revenue_basis,
    gross_profit,
    operating_profit,
    profit_before_tax,
    net_profit_after_tax,
    net_profit_parent,
    total_assets,
    total_assets_basis,
    total_liabilities,
    equity,
    cash_and_equivalents,
    net_cash_from_operating,
    net_cash_from_investing,
    net_cash_from_financing,
    case when revenue > 0 then gross_profit / revenue end             as gross_margin,
    case when revenue > 0 then net_profit_after_tax / revenue end     as net_margin,
    case when equity > 0 then total_liabilities / equity end          as debt_to_equity,
    case when total_assets > 0 then total_liabilities / total_assets end as liabilities_to_assets,
    case when equity > 0 then net_profit_after_tax / equity end       as roe_quarter,
    case when total_assets > 0 then net_profit_after_tax / total_assets end as roa_quarter,
    prev_period,
    case when prev_revenue > 0 and not is_period_suspect and not prev_is_period_suspect
         then revenue / prev_revenue - 1 end                          as revenue_growth_qoq,
    case when prev_net_profit_after_tax > 0 and not is_period_suspect and not prev_is_period_suspect
         then net_profit_after_tax / prev_net_profit_after_tax - 1 end as net_profit_growth_qoq,
    balance_identity_ratio,
    equity_scale_ratio,
    is_period_suspect,
    metrics_total,
    metrics_with_value
from with_prev

-- Chỉ báo kỹ thuật theo ngày. Grain: 1 mã / 1 ngày giao dịch.
-- Mọi cửa sổ tính trên chuỗi phiên giao dịch của chính mã đó; chỉ báo để NULL khi chưa đủ số phiên.
-- RSI14 dùng trung bình đơn giản của mức tăng/giảm 14 phiên (biến thể Cutler), không phải làm mượt Wilder.
with px as (

    select
        ticker_key,
        date_key,
        symbol,
        trade_date,
        close,
        volume,
        row_number() over (partition by symbol order by trade_date)  as session_no,
        lag(close) over (partition by symbol order by trade_date)    as prev_close,
        lag(close, 5) over (partition by symbol order by trade_date) as close_5d_ago,
        lag(close, 20) over (partition by symbol order by trade_date) as close_20d_ago
    from `vnstock-medallion-nhom10`.`gold`.`fact_price_daily`

),

ret as (

    select
        *,
        close / prev_close - 1                                       as daily_return,
        ln(close / prev_close)                                       as log_return,
        case when close > prev_close then close - prev_close else 0 end as gain,
        case when close < prev_close then prev_close - close else 0 end as loss
    from px

),

win as (

    select
        *,
        avg(close) over (partition by symbol order by trade_date rows between 19 preceding and current row) as sma20_raw,
        avg(close) over (partition by symbol order by trade_date rows between 49 preceding and current row) as sma50_raw,
        avg(gain) over (partition by symbol order by trade_date rows between 13 preceding and current row)  as avg_gain_14,
        avg(loss) over (partition by symbol order by trade_date rows between 13 preceding and current row)  as avg_loss_14,
        stddev_samp(daily_return) over (partition by symbol order by trade_date rows between 19 preceding and current row) as vol_20_raw,
        avg(volume) over (partition by symbol order by trade_date rows between 20 preceding and 1 preceding) as avg_volume_20d_raw,
        max(close) over (partition by symbol order by trade_date rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_max_close
    from ret

)

select
    ticker_key,
    date_key,
    symbol,
    trade_date,
    session_no,
    close,
    volume,
    prev_close,
    daily_return,
    log_return,
    case when close_5d_ago > 0 then close / close_5d_ago - 1 end     as return_5d,
    case when close_20d_ago > 0 then close / close_20d_ago - 1 end   as return_20d,
    case when session_no >= 20 then sma20_raw end                    as sma20,
    case when session_no >= 50 then sma50_raw end                    as sma50,
    case
        when session_no < 15 then null                               -- cần 14 thay đổi giá
        when avg_loss_14 = 0 and avg_gain_14 = 0 then 50
        when avg_loss_14 = 0 then 100
        else 100 - 100 / (1 + avg_gain_14 / avg_loss_14)
    end                                                              as rsi14,
    case when session_no >= 21 then vol_20_raw end                   as volatility_20d,
    case when session_no >= 21 then vol_20_raw * sqrt(252) end       as volatility_20d_annualized,
    case when session_no >= 21 then avg_volume_20d_raw end           as avg_volume_20d,
    case when session_no >= 21 and avg_volume_20d_raw > 0
         then volume / avg_volume_20d_raw end                        as volume_ratio_20d,
    running_max_close,
    close / running_max_close - 1                                    as drawdown
from win

-- Đây là tín hiệu MINH HỌA dựa trên quy tắc, không phải khuyến nghị giao dịch.
-- Các quy tắc dạng "vùng" (RSI, drawdown) chỉ phát tín hiệu tại phiên VỪA cắt ngưỡng để tránh lặp.





with t as (

    select
        *,
        lag(sma20) over (partition by symbol order by trade_date)    as prev_sma20,
        lag(sma50) over (partition by symbol order by trade_date)    as prev_sma50,
        lag(rsi14) over (partition by symbol order by trade_date)    as prev_rsi14,
        lag(drawdown) over (partition by symbol order by trade_date) as prev_drawdown
    from `vnstock-medallion-nhom10`.`gold`.`mart_technical_indicators`

),

alerts as (

    select symbol, trade_date, ticker_key, date_key, close,
           'GOLDEN_CROSS' as rule_code, 'bullish' as signal,
           sma20 / sma50 - 1 as observed_value, cast(0 as float64) as threshold_value,
           'SMA20 (' || cast(round(cast(sma20 as numeric), 2) as string) || ') cắt lên trên SMA50 (' || cast(round(cast(sma50 as numeric), 2) as string) || ')' as reason
    from t
    where sma20 > sma50 and prev_sma20 <= prev_sma50

    union all
    select symbol, trade_date, ticker_key, date_key, close,
           'DEATH_CROSS', 'bearish', sma20 / sma50 - 1, cast(0 as float64),
           'SMA20 (' || cast(round(cast(sma20 as numeric), 2) as string) || ') cắt xuống dưới SMA50 (' || cast(round(cast(sma50 as numeric), 2) as string) || ')'
    from t
    where sma20 < sma50 and prev_sma20 >= prev_sma50

    union all
    select symbol, trade_date, ticker_key, date_key, close,
           'RSI_OVERBOUGHT', 'bearish', rsi14, cast(70 as float64),
           'RSI14 = ' || cast(round(cast(rsi14 as numeric), 1) as string) || ' vượt lên ngưỡng quá mua 70'
    from t
    where rsi14 >= 70 and prev_rsi14 < 70

    union all
    select symbol, trade_date, ticker_key, date_key, close,
           'RSI_OVERSOLD', 'bullish', rsi14, cast(30 as float64),
           'RSI14 = ' || cast(round(cast(rsi14 as numeric), 1) as string) || ' rơi xuống ngưỡng quá bán 30'
    from t
    where rsi14 <= 30 and prev_rsi14 > 30

    union all
    select symbol, trade_date, ticker_key, date_key, close,
           'VOLUME_SPIKE', 'neutral', volume_ratio_20d, cast(2.5 as float64),
           'Khối lượng gấp ' || cast(round(cast(volume_ratio_20d as numeric), 2) as string) || ' lần trung bình 20 phiên trước (ngưỡng 2.5)'
    from t
    where volume_ratio_20d >= 2.5

    union all
    select symbol, trade_date, ticker_key, date_key, close,
           'LARGE_MOVE_UP', 'bullish', daily_return, cast(0.05 as float64),
           'Giá đóng cửa tăng ' || cast(round(cast(daily_return * 100 as numeric), 2) as string) || '% trong phiên (ngưỡng 5.0%)'
    from t
    where daily_return >= 0.05

    union all
    select symbol, trade_date, ticker_key, date_key, close,
           'LARGE_MOVE_DOWN', 'bearish', daily_return, cast(-0.05 as float64),
           'Giá đóng cửa giảm ' || cast(round(cast(abs(daily_return) * 100 as numeric), 2) as string) || '% trong phiên (ngưỡng 5.0%)'
    from t
    where daily_return <= -0.05

    union all
    select symbol, trade_date, ticker_key, date_key, close,
           'DEEP_DRAWDOWN', 'bearish', drawdown, cast(-0.2 as float64),
           'Giá giảm ' || cast(round(cast(abs(drawdown) * 100 as numeric), 2) as string) || '% so với đỉnh (' || cast(round(cast(running_max_close as numeric), 2) as string)
               || '), vượt ngưỡng -20.0%'
    from t
    where drawdown <= -0.2 and prev_drawdown > -0.2

)

-- So sánh cổ phiếu với VN-Index. Grain: 1 mã / 1 chỉ số / 1 ngày giao dịch.
-- Chỉ tính trên khoảng ngày CHUNG (chỉ số bắt đầu muộn hơn giá cổ phiếu); mốc so sánh lũy kế
-- là phiên chung đầu tiên của từng mã.
with stock as (

    select ticker_key, date_key, symbol, trade_date, close, daily_return
    from `vnstock-medallion-nhom10`.`gold`.`mart_technical_indicators`

),

idx as (

    select
        index_code,
        trade_date,
        close                                                        as index_close,
        close / lag(close) over (partition by index_code order by trade_date) - 1 as index_return
    from `vnstock-medallion-nhom10`.`gold`.`fact_index_daily`

),

joined as (

    select
        s.ticker_key,
        s.date_key,
        s.symbol,
        i.index_code,
        s.trade_date,
        s.close                                                      as stock_close,
        i.index_close,
        s.daily_return                                               as stock_return,
        i.index_return,
        first_value(s.close) over (partition by s.symbol, i.index_code order by s.trade_date
                                   rows between unbounded preceding and unbounded following) as stock_base_close,
        first_value(i.index_close) over (partition by s.symbol, i.index_code order by s.trade_date
                                   rows between unbounded preceding and unbounded following) as index_base_close,
        min(s.trade_date) over (partition by s.symbol, i.index_code) as common_start_date,
        row_number() over (partition by s.symbol, i.index_code order by s.trade_date) as common_session_no,
        lag(s.close, 20) over (partition by s.symbol, i.index_code order by s.trade_date) as stock_close_20d_ago,
        lag(i.index_close, 20) over (partition by s.symbol, i.index_code order by s.trade_date) as index_close_20d_ago
    from stock s
    inner join idx i on i.trade_date = s.trade_date

),

calc as (

    select
        *,
        covar_samp(stock_return, index_return) over (partition by symbol, index_code order by trade_date
                                                     rows between 59 preceding and current row) as covar_60,
        var_samp(index_return) over (partition by symbol, index_code order by trade_date
                                     rows between 59 preceding and current row)                as index_var_60
    from joined
